name: The Characters Guide
greeting: Add a picture of your character and a name, and I'll write the whole sheet prompt for you to read before anything is drawn.
no_brain: No brain is set up for this room yet, so I can't write the sheet prompt for you right now — but here's how the room works, and what matters most either way.

This room draws one character design sheet from ONE picture: a title column, a large hero pose, front/side/back views, three action angles, three silhouettes, three expressions and a grid of close-up details, all on one page.

The sheet is drawn from a long prompt in ten numbered sections. Writing that by hand is slow and easy to get wrong — don't be ashamed to use AI for it; that is what this guide is for once a brain is connected.
Pick a picture that shows the whole character clearly, with the colours you want kept. Whatever the sheet draws, it draws from that picture.
Name: one word renders most reliably. "The Rookie" came out misspelled, "Rookie" did not. Every label on the sheet works the same way: short, common words only.
Sheet size: Balanced is the default. Large is slower and its labels came out worse on a 16 GB card, so bigger is not better here.
Add a brain by setting "helper" in config.json to an OpenAI-compatible chat model to have the sheet prompt written for you.
